description: Thread-safe generic bidirectional map for .NET. O(1) lookups in both directions with a strict 1-to-1 mapping.
rules: BiMap<TLeft, TRight> is IDisposable — it holds a ReaderWriterLockSlim. Dispose it, or declare it with using, when the map is not a long-lived singleton.
There is no indexer. Read with GetLeftToRight(left) / GetRightToLeft(right), or TryGetLeftToRight / TryGetRightToLeft when the key may be absent.
Removal is direction-specific: RemoveByLeft(left) and RemoveByRight(right). There is no plain Remove.
Add(left, right) returns false rather than throwing when either side already exists. Both the left and the right value must be unique across the map, so check the return value.
Containment is direction-specific too: ContainsLeft(left) and ContainsRight(right).
Enumerate with EnumerateLeftToRight() or EnumerateRightToLeft(); the type is not itself IEnumerable.
Targets netstandard2.0, so it works on .NET Framework 4.6.1+ as well as modern .NET.
